sections.title: Espresso & Coffee Classics
sections.description: Carefully crafted with specialty beans roasted locally and brewed on commercial espresso machines.

items.name: Black Coffee
items.description: Rich double-shot extraction highlighting nuanced origin notes and clean finish.

items.name: White Coffee
items.description: Velvety textured milk poured over double espresso with delicate latte art.

items.name: Mocha
items.description: Rich dark cocoa blended with hot espresso and silky steamed milk.

items.name: Fluffy
items.description: Fluffy frothed warm milk dusted with cocoa, served with marshmallows.

sections.title: House Signatures & Specialty Drinks
sections.description: Handcrafted signature drinks that define the Aura Roast experience.

items.name: Sea Salt Coffee
items.subname: Sea Salt Cream Cold Brew / Iced Latte
items.description: Our most loved house specialty: rich espresso layered over chilled milk, topped with a velvety savoury sea-salt cream foam.

items.name: Dirty Latte
items.subname: Double Ristretto over chilled rich milk
items.description: Two hot ristretto shots pulled directly onto cold, heavy dairy milk creating bold contrasting layers.

items.name: Matcha Latte
items.description: Finely ground Japanese matcha whisked smooth with steamed velvety milk.

items.name: Chai Latte
items.description: Aromatic spices slow-infused with black tea and honeyed milk, topped with cinnamon.

items.name: Hot Chocolate
items.description: Decadent creamy chocolate melted with textured milk and chocolate dusting.

items.name: Lemon Honey Infusion
items.description: Fresh lemon steep with New Zealand honey, perfect for calming and warming.

items.name: House-made Fruit Soda
items.description: Craft fruit puree and botanical syrups served over ice with sparkling water.

items.name: Fresh Fruit Smoothie
items.description: Real fruit blended with milk or plant milk base for a nourishing energy boost.

sections.title: Certified Organic & Japanese Teas
sections.description: Served in individual ceramic teaware and vintage teapots for an authentic, mindful tea experience.

items.name: Zealong Sweet Amber Black Tea
items.description: Smooth, naturally sweet organic black tea with floral honey and malt undertones.

items.name: Zealong Lady Gatsby Green Tea
items.subname: Organic green tea with rose, manuka & cinnamon
items.description: A fragrant, uplifting botanical green tea blend featuring native New Zealand manuka.

items.name: Zealong Aromatic Oolong Tea
items.description: Traditional roasted oolong offering complex orchid aromatics and rich lingering sweetness.

items.name: Zealong Ice Breaker Botanical
items.description: Crisp and refreshing botanical infusion, naturally caffeine-free.

items.name: Lupicia Momo Oolong
items.description: Delicate Taiwanese oolong blended with sweet Japanese white peach aroma.

items.name: Lupicia Rose Royal
items.subname: Black tea infused with strawberry & rose
items.description: Elegantly blended black tea with sweet strawberry notes and tender rose petals, as praised by customer reviews.

items.name: Lupicia Grapefruit Green Tea
items.description: Refreshing green tea with citrus grapefruit notes, crisp served hot or chilled.

sections.title: Fresh Cabinet Savouries
sections.description: Baked fresh daily and toasted to perfection upon ordering. Ideal for quick lunches or sit-down meals.

items.name: Bacon & Cheese Savoury Quiche
items.subname: Flaky pastry with savoury egg custard
items.description: Golden crust loaded with smoked bacon lardons, aged cheddar cheese, and fresh garden herbs.

items.name: Ham & Cheese Toasted Croissant
items.description: Flaky French all-butter croissant filled with premium shaved ham and melted mozzarella.

items.name: Roasted Mushroom & Herb Pastry
items.description: Slow-roasted garlic mushrooms, thyme, and creamy cheese wrapped in crisp puff pastry.

items.name: Bacon & Egg Breakfast Bap
items.description: Crispy bacon, fried egg, and relish packed in a soft brioche bap.

items.name: Cajun Chicken Salad Wrap
items.description: Succulent spiced chicken breast, crunchy greens, tomatoes, and aioli in a soft tortilla.

items.name: Artisan Beef Sandwich
items.description: Tender seasoned beef cuts, caramelised onions, pickles, and mustard on crusty sourdough.

items.name: Beef Meatball Pasta Bake
items.description: Homestyle Italian-style beef meatballs in rich tomato sugo over pasta, topped with melted parmesan.

sections.title: Bakery & Sweet Treats
sections.description: Indulgent treats paired perfectly with espresso or a pot of loose-leaf tea.

items.name: French Macarons
items.description: Delicate Parisian macarons in alternating flavors: Pistachio, Raspberry, Dark Chocolate, Salted Caramel.

items.name: Zesty Lemon Tart
items.description: Tangy lemon curd set in crisp pastry shell, lightly glazed with icing sugar.

items.name: Classic Pecan Tart
items.description: Toasted whole pecans baked in rich maple and brown sugar caramel filling.

items.name: Blueberry Cream Cheese Muffin
items.description: Loaded with juicy blueberries and a molten cream cheese center, topped with crumble.
